newsitem.title: SPAIN: Profit-taking skims top off Madrid stocks at noon.
newsitem.headline: Profit-taking skims top off Madrid stocks at noon.

text.p: Madrid stocks were flat at midday on Monday after profit-taking took its toll in cautious trade, with all eyes on the European summit, dealers said.

The Amsterdam EU meeting is expected to provide indications on how an agreement to promote job creation will be incorporated into the stability pact without harming fiscal austerity, thus paving the way for the single currency to go ahead, they said.
The general index shed 1.06 points, 0.18 percent, to 581.23 while the Ibex was up 1.99 points, 0.03 percent, to 6,687.27.
"We've seen a technical adjustment lower after the market tested highs. Everyone's waiting for some word from the summit to give the market direction medium-term," a dealer said.
